name: Rheinfelden (Baden, Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of green, red and yellow, charged with the figure of the city arms of Rheinfelden (Baden), a black lion holding a red rose.
history: Municipal flag of Rheinfelden (Baden); German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
